WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT home_store_id, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS dm, min(valid_from), max(valid_from)
FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(home_store_id) ORDER BY 1

SELECT max(join_date) AS max_join, max(valid_from) AS max_vf, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale, (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_etl, count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys FROM dim_member

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, valid_from, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS any_version_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date = DATE '2026-09-25') AS first_version_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND valid_from = DATE '2026-09-25') AS first_vf_0925,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND valid_from <> join_date) AS vf_ne_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT join_date)>1)) AS multi_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id, valid_from FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_versions,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-09-25' AND valid_from <> DATE '2026-09-25') AS later_versions_0925
